Durgapur is a steel city — the Durgapur Steel Plant, the Heavy Engineering Plant, the alloy and power units along the belt keep work going that needs site offices, gate cabins, and supervisor rooms built to take heat, dust, and heavy site use. SAMAN builds those cabins. For a porta cabin in Durgapur, we manufacture IS 2062 MS-frame units at our Greater Noida factory and send them east in 4 to 6 days, finished with anti-rust coatings as standard. A guard cabin at a DSP contractor gate or a multi-room block on a plant project — call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 and we'll quote it.

Why Buy Your Porta Cabin From SAMAN

Search "porta cabin in Durgapur" and you mostly get IndiaMART supplier cards — prices from about ₹50,000 up past ₹2.1 lakh, with per-sq-ft rates around ₹1,200, and not much to choose between sellers. The cards rarely say the steel grade, the panel thickness, or how the cabin's coated against a dusty steel yard. For a DSP contractor or a Heavy Engineering Plant project running for years, that's the detail that decides whether the cabin lasts.

We make the cabins, so when you call you reach the people who build them. Standard on every SAMAN unit:

  • A frame in IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections — welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, then anchor-bolted to your plinth so it holds on a busy plant site.
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panel walls — insulation that keeps the cabin workable through a Bengal summer.
  • A colour-coated GI roof, pitched hard for the monsoon, with a false ceiling under it.
  • A pre-wired board — MCB, ELCB earthing, points and tube-light provision.

The paperwork is real. ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. We started in 2009 and incorporated in 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd — POS is Portable Office Solutions. Over 500 projects delivered, with cabins going out to sites right across the country, the eastern steel belt included. For the full range and build options, see our porta cabins.

Delivery runs ₹3,000 standard, transit to Durgapur is 4–6 days given the distance, and returns are 7 days with the return freight on you.

Where Porta Cabins Go to Work in Durgapur

Durgapur's heavy industry decides what cabin a buyer needs, and the belt pulls serious work:

Durgapur Steel Plant and its belt (PIN 713203): the SAIL plant and the ring of contractors, fabricators, and vendors around it. Steady demand for gate and weighbridge security cabins, QC cabins, and supervisor offices, all of which take a beating from dust and heat and need a coating that holds.

Durgapur Heavy Engineering Plant / V.K. Nagar (PIN 713210): the engineering and project belt. Large jobs and shutdown work that need multi-room contractor offices and worker accommodation, often several cabins at once.

City Centre and the industrial estate (PIN 713216): the commercial and mixed industrial core, plus the alloy and power units spreading out from it. Site offices, stores, and security cabins through build and project phases.

Beyond the plants there's the construction side: the Durgapur Expressway and NH-19 corridor, warehouse and logistics parks, and infrastructure across the Asansol-Durgapur belt. All of it runs on porta cabins for the site office and the gate.

We dispatch from Greater Noida east across UP and Bihar into Bengal — Durgapur is a longer haul than our NCR cities, so plan 4–6 days in transit, and we'll tell you straight rather than promise a date we can't hold. A porta cabin in Durgapur ships on the same eastern run that backs our porta cabin in Jamshedpur and porta cabin in Rourkela deliveries across the steel belt.

What You're Actually Getting — Specifications

Built for Durgapur's heat, dust, and a heavy industrial setting.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow sections, welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth. The coating matters in a steel-yard setting — a dusty plant is hard on bare steel.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panel standard. Cement board for a tougher skin on a long posting in a dusty plant.

Roof: colour-coated GI, pitched for the Bengal monsoon, false ceiling beneath. Turbo ventilators worth adding on open plant plots.

Floor: anti-skid chequered MS plate — the practical choice in a dusty yard — or laminate for a sit-down office.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coated, with sealed louvre or sliding windows to keep plant dust out. Fixed glazing on request. All fitted at the factory.

Electricals: MCB board pre-wired, 2 to 4 points a room, tube-light points, ELCB earthing.

Sizes off the shelf: 8×10, 10×12, 10×20 (the common 20 ft office), 10×30, 10×40 (the 40 ft block). Odd size? We'll build to it.

Layouts: single room, two-room, a full multi-room block, with an attached toilet or a pantry if you need one.

What People in Durgapur Use Them For

  • Gate security and weighbridge cabins at DSP and plant entries
  • Multi-room contractor offices on Steel Plant and Heavy Engineering projects
  • QC and inspection cabins near plant lines
  • Worker accommodation blocks on the larger plant and infrastructure sites
  • Site offices on expressway and warehouse construction
  • Tool and material stores at project yards

Customising It to Your Site

Most Durgapur orders aren't the bare standard. Common changes:

  • Custom size and multi-room layouts
  • Heavier anti-rust coating spec for a dusty, high-heat plant posting
  • Sealed windows and doors to keep plant dust out
  • AC provision (wall sleeve cut and a power point) for a working office
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for open plots
  • Internal partitions, extra doors or windows; plumbing for an attached toilet
  • Two-storey stacking where the load numbers allow

Tell us the plant and the use; we'll confirm the spec and the price at quote stage.

What a Porta Cabin Costs in Durgapur

On the marketplaces you'll see Durgapur prices from about ₹50,000 for a small basic unit up past ₹2.1 lakh, with per-sq-ft rates around ₹1,200. The spread is wide because no two cabins are the same. What moves the number:

  1. Size — an 8×10 single room is the floor, a 10×40 block the ceiling.
  2. Panel — standard PUF, or cement board for a harder build.
  3. Coating — a heavier anti-rust spec for a dusty plant adds cost but pays off.
  4. Fit-out — bare shell, or fully done with wiring, flooring, paint and AC.
  5. Quantity — order five or more and the per-unit price comes down.

For a real number on your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Getting It to Your Durgapur Site

We load on a flatbed at Greater Noida and run it east across UP and Bihar into Bengal — the same factory-direct dispatch behind the porta cabins we deliver into Kolkata and across the east, just a longer leg to Durgapur. Four to six days in transit, and we'll be honest about timing rather than over-promise. On arrival we set the cabin on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolt it, check the panels, and connect the board. A single room is usable within hours; a multi-room block settles in about a day. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard, with a combined rate for several cabins. To be clear: we don't run a yard or branch in Durgapur. Every cabin is built to your order at the factory and trucked the full way to your plant.

Looking After It

A SAMAN cabin needs very little. Wash the plant dust off the panels now and then, keep the roof drains clear before the monsoon, and check the door and window fittings once a year. The powder-coated MS frame and GI roof take years of plant-site use with that light attention — and for a really dusty posting we can spec the heavier coating up front so it lasts even longer.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Durgapur

Do you deliver porta cabins to the Durgapur Steel Plant belt?

Yes — the DSP belt, the Heavy Engineering / V.K. Nagar area, City Centre, and project sites across the Durgapur region. The cabin ships from our Greater Noida factory and takes 4–6 days in transit, since Durgapur is a longer haul. Delivery is ₹3,000 standard.

Will the cabin hold up in a dusty, high-heat steel-belt plant?

That's what it's built for. The frame is IS 2062 steel, zinc-phosphate primed and powder-coated, and for a dusty steel-yard posting we can spec a heavier anti-rust coating and seal the windows and doors to keep plant dust out. The 50 mm PUF panels handle the heat. Tell us the plant conditions and we'll match the spec.

What does a porta cabin cost in Durgapur?

Marketplace listings run from about ₹50,000 to over ₹2.1 lakh, around ₹1,200 a square foot — but the real number depends on size, panel type, coating spec, fit-out and quantity. We quote against your exact spec rather than publish a fixed price. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry.

Can you supply multiple cabins for a DSP or DHEP project?

Yes — multi-cabin plant orders are routine for us. We supply contractors and project managers, and our NSIC, DPIIT, ISO certificates, GST registration and incorporation papers are ready for vendor empanelment. Send the project scope and we'll confirm capacity, freight, and timeline.

How long does delivery to Durgapur take?

Transit is 4–6 days once the cabin's built, since Durgapur is well east of our NCR cities. We plan for the upper end and tell you straight rather than promise a date we can't hold. Production time depends on the configuration and your place in the queue — we'll confirm a firm timeline at enquiry.

Get a Porta Cabin in Durgapur

Need a porta cabin in Durgapur — for a Steel Plant contractor gate, a Heavy Engineering project, or an expressway construction site? Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or drop your requirement in the enquiry form. We'll come back with the right spec for your plant conditions, an honest delivery timeline, and a firm price. You can also browse our steel-frame porta cabins built for industry for sizes and configurations.
